truepass: what makes a test suite report green without the code passing.

```ts
import { parseUnifiedDiff, unexplainedSnapshots, weakenedAssertions, … } from 'truepass';
```

## Functions

### budgetFrom

The budget a run is held to: `fallback`, or `TRUEPASS_BUDGET_MS` when set. `0` is off.

```ts
function budgetFrom(env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv, fallback?: number): number;
```

| :-- | :-- |
| `env` | `NodeJS.ProcessEnv` |
| `fallback` (optional) | `number` |

**Returns** `number`

### judge

The verdict on `candidates`: each measured alone, the ones still over `budget` named. Returns
whether the gate passed.

```ts
function judge(candidates: readonly Candidate[], budget: number, hint?: string, machine?: Machine): Promise<boolean>;
```

| Parameter | Type |
| :-- | :-- |
| `candidates` | `readonly Candidate[]` |
| `budget` | `number` |
| `hint` (optional) | `string` |
| `machine` (optional) | `Machine` |

**Returns** `Promise<boolean>`


| Parameter | Type |
| :-- | :-- |
| `cases` | `readonly T[]` |

| `exempt` (optional) | `Exemptions` |

**Returns** `T[]`

### unexplainedSnapshots

A changed snapshot needs a `Snapshot: <reason>` line in one of the range's
commit messages — updating a snapshot is how a wrong output becomes the
expected one, so the change has to say what it accepts.

```ts
function unexplainedSnapshots(changedPaths: string[], commitMessages: string): Finding[];
```

| Parameter | Type |
| :-- | :-- |
| `changedPaths` | `string[]` |
| `commitMessages` | `string` |

**Returns** `Finding[]`

### weakenedAssertions

Assertions on the same subject that moved to a weaker matcher. An
`Assertion: <why>` line in one of the range's commit messages accepts them.

```ts
function weakenedAssertions(files: FileDiff[], commitMessages: string): Finding[];
```

| Parameter | Type |
| :-- | :-- |
| `files` | `FileDiff[]` |
| `commitMessages` | `string` |

**Returns** `Finding[]`

## Constants

### BUDGET_ENV

Sets the budget for a run; `0` turns the gate off.

```ts
const BUDGET_ENV = "TRUEPASS_BUDGET_MS";
```

### caseKey

The key exemptions are written in.

```ts
const caseKey: (c: Pick<CaseDuration, "file" | "name">) => string;
```

### DEFAULT_BUDGET_MS

The default budget: a case at exactly the budget is within it.

```ts
const DEFAULT_BUDGET_MS = 5000;
```

### DEFER_ENV

Where a run inside a battery leaves its candidates for `truepass budget <dir>`.

```ts
const DEFER_ENV = "TRUEPASS_BUDGET_DEFER";
```

### MATCHER_RANK

Strictness, strongest first. A change that moves an assertion on the same
subject to a lower rank accepts more wrong answers than it did.

```ts
const MATCHER_RANK: Readonly<Record<string, number>>;
```

### program

```ts
const program: import("burgee").Manifest;
```

## Interfaces

### Candidate

A case read over the budget, with what it takes to run it again.

```ts
interface Candidate extends CaseDuration {
    /** The case's own title, for `-t`. */
    title: string;
    /** The absolute path of the test file. */
    path: string;
    /** The directory vitest ran in. */
    cwd: string;
    /** The vitest config the run used, if any. */
    config: string | undefined;
    /** The budget the run that read it held it to, so `truepass budget` judges it by the same one. */
    budget?: number | undefined;
}
```

### CaseDuration

One case and how long it took. `file` is relative to the repository root, with `/`.

```ts
interface CaseDuration {
    file: string;
    name: string;
    duration: number;
    /** The best reading taken alone, when the first was over the budget. */
    alone?: number | undefined;
}
```

### ChangedLine

The two truepass checks a lint rule cannot make, because they are
about what a change did rather than what a file says: an assertion moved to
a weaker matcher, and a snapshot rewritten with no reason given.

```ts
interface ChangedLine {
    line: number;
    text: string;
}
```

### FileDiff

```ts
interface FileDiff {
    path: string;
    hunks: Hunk[];
}
```

### Finding

```ts
interface Finding {
    check: 'weakened-assertion' | 'unexplained-snapshot';
    path: string;
    line: number;
    message: string;
}
```

### Hunk

```ts
interface Hunk {
    removed: ChangedLine[];
    added: ChangedLine[];
}
```

### Machine

What `judge` reads from the machine; the tests pass their own.

```ts
interface Machine {
    env: NodeJS.ProcessEnv;
    measure: (c: Candidate) => Promise<number | undefined>;
    overloaded: () => boolean;
    now: () => number;
    write: (text: string) => void;
    cores: number;
}
```

## Types

### Exemptions

Cases that may take longer, keyed `<file> > <full name>`, each with the reason.

```ts
type Exemptions = Readonly<Record<string, string>>;
```
